title: China plans job safeguards as AI adoption accelerates
event_date: Ministry action plan outlined Saturday 10 Oct 2026; MLex article published 12 Oct 2026.
notes: MLex paywall. Page description (standfirst) says China is seeking to cushion workers from the impact of AI on jobs while accelerating adoption, during the next five-year plan through 2030, and that the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security outlined an action plan Saturday to promote employment as AI develops, including training tailored to workers, people in specialised roles, students and the wider public. Same announcement as our 10 Oct edition item 96 (Global Times).
